ayahs.tl: Taa-Seeen-Meeem
ayahs.en: Ta, Seen, Meem.

ayahs.tl: Tilka Aayaatul Kitaabil Mubeen
ayahs.en: These are the verses of the clear Book.

ayahs.ar: لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفۡسَكَ اَلَّا يَكُوۡنُوۡا مُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: La'allaka baakhi'un nafsaka allaa yakoonoo mu'mineen
ayahs.en: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ نَّشَاۡ نُنَزِّلۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ اٰيَةً فَظَلَّتۡ اَعۡنَاقُهُمۡ لَهَا خٰضِعِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: In nashaa nunazzil 'alaihim minas samaaa'i Aayatan fazallat a'naaquhum lahaa khaadi'een
ayahs.en: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ ذِكۡرٍ مِّنَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ مُحۡدَثٍ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa yaateehim min zikrim minar Rahmaani muhdasin illaa kaanoo 'anhu mu'rideen
ayahs.en: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.

ayahs.ar: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُوۡا فَسَيَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ اَنۭۡ بٰٓؤُا مَا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Faqad kazzaboo fasa yaateehim ambaaa'u maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
ayahs.en: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اِلَي الۡاَرۡضِ كَمۡ اَنۭۡ بَتۡنَا فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلِّ زَوۡجٍ كَرِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Awa lam yaraw ilal ardi kam ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjin kareem
ayahs.en: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Inn fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen
ayahs.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

ayahs.tl: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
ayahs.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ نَادٰي رَبُّكَ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اَنِ ائۡتِ الۡقَوۡمَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa iz naadaa Rabbuka Moosaaa ani'-til qawmaz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -

ayahs.tl: Qawma Fir'awn; alaa yattaqoon
ayahs.en: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ اَنۡ يُّكَذِّبُوۡنِؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbi inneee akhaafu ai yukazziboon
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me

ayahs.ar: وَيَضِيۡقُ صَدۡرِيۡ وَلَا يَنۡطَلِقُ لِسَانِيۡ فَاَرۡسِلۡ اِلٰي هٰرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yadeequ sadree wa laa yantaliqu lisaanee fa arsil ilaa Haaroon
ayahs.en: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.

ayahs.ar: وَلَهُمۡ عَلَيَّ ذَنۭۡ بٌ فَاَخَافُ اَنۡ يَّقۡتُلُوۡنِۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa lahum 'alaiya zambun fa akhaafu ai yaqtuloon
ayahs.en: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ كَلَّاۚ فَاذۡهَبَا بِاٰيٰتِنَا٘ اِنَّا مَعَكُمۡ مُّسۡتَمِعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala kallaa fazhabaa bi Aayaatinaaa innaa ma'akum mustami'oon
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.

ayahs.ar: فَاۡتِيَا فِرۡعَوۡنَ فَقُوۡلَا٘ اِنَّا رَسُوۡلُ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Faatiyaa Fir'awna faqoolaaa innaa Rasoolu Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,

ayahs.tl: An arsil ma'anaa Baneee Israaa'eel
ayahs.en: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اَلَمۡ نُرَبِّكَ فِيۡنَا وَلِيۡدًا وَّلَبِثۡتَ فِيۡنَا مِنۡ عُمُرِكَ سِنِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala alam nurabbika feenaa waleedanw wa labista feenaa min 'umurika sineen
ayahs.en: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?

ayahs.ar: وَفَعَلۡتَ فَعۡلَتَكَ الَّتِيۡ فَعَلۡتَ وَاَنۡتَ مِنَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa fa'alta fa'latakal latee fa'alta wa anta minal kaafireen
ayahs.en: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَعَلۡتُهَا٘ اِذًا وَّاَنَا مِنَ الضَّآلِّيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala fa'altuhaaa izanw wa ana minad daaaleen
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray.

ayahs.ar: فَفَرَرۡتُ مِنۡكُمۡ لَمَّا خِفۡتُكُمۡ فَوَهَبَ لِيۡ رَبِّيۡ حُكۡمًا وَّجَعَلَنِيۡ مِنَ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fafarartu minkum lam maa khiftukum fawahaba lee Rabbee hukmanw wa ja'alanee minal mursaleen
ayahs.en: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.

ayahs.ar: وَتِلۡكَ نِعۡمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ اَنۡ عَبَّدۡتَّ بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa tilka ni'matun tamun nuhaa 'alaiya an 'abbatta Baneee Israaa'eel
ayahs.en: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"

ayahs.tl: Qaala Fir'awnu wa maa Rabbul 'aalameen
ayahs.en: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاؕ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ مُّوۡقِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa in kuntum mooqineen
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."

ayahs.tl: Qaala liman hawlahooo alaa tastami'oon
ayahs.en: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"

ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbukum wa Rabbu aabaaa'ikumul awwaleen
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اِنَّ رَسُوۡلَكُمُ الَّذِيۡ٘ اُرۡسِلَ اِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمَجۡنُوۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Qaala inna Rasoolakumul lazee ursila ilaikum lamajnoon
ayahs.en: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ الۡمَشۡرِقِ وَالۡمَغۡرِبِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاؕ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbul mashriqi wal maghribi wa maa baina humaa in kuntum ta'qiloon
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَئِنِ اتَّخَذۡتَ اِلٰهًا غَيۡرِيۡ لَاَجۡعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ الۡمَسۡجُوۡنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala la'init takhazta ilaahan ghairee la aj'alannaka minal masjooneen
ayahs.en: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."

ayahs.tl: Qaala awalw ji'tuka bishai'im mubeen
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَاۡتِ بِهٖ٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala faati biheee in kunta minas saadiqeen
ayahs.en: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."

ayahs.ar: فَاَلۡقٰي عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِيَ ثُعۡبَانٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa alqaa 'asaahu fa izaaa hiya su'baanum mubeen
ayahs.en: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.

ayahs.ar: وَّنَزَعَ يَدَهٗ فَاِذَا هِيَ بَيۡضَآءُ لِلنّٰظِرِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa naza'a yadahoo faizaa hiya baidaaa'u linnaa zireen
ayahs.en: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لِلۡمَلَاِ حَوۡلَهٗ٘ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَسٰحِرٌ عَلِيۡمٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala lilmala-i hawlahooo inna haazaa lasaahirun 'aleem
ayahs.en: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.

ayahs.ar: يُّرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يُّخۡرِجَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَرۡضِكُمۡ بِسِحۡرِهٖࣗۖ فَمَاذَا تَاۡمُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yureedu ai yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihee famaazaa taamuroon
ayahs.en: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اَرۡجِهۡ وَاَخَاهُ وَابۡعَثۡ فِي الۡمَدَآئِنِ حٰشِرِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaalooo arjih wa akhaahu wab'as filmadaaa'ini haashireen
ayahs.en: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers

ayahs.tl: Yaatooka bikulli sah haarin 'aleem
ayahs.en: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."

ayahs.tl: Fa jumi'as saharatu limeeqaati Yawmim ma'loom
ayahs.en: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.

ayahs.tl: Wa qeela linnaasi hal antum mujtami'oon
ayahs.en: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate

ayahs.ar: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ اِنۡ كَانُوۡا هُمُ الۡغٰلِبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: La'allanaa nattabi'us saharata in kaanoo humul ghaalibeen
ayahs.en: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالُوۡا لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ اَئِنَّ لَنَا لَاَجۡرًا اِنۡ كُنَّا نَحۡنُ الۡغٰلِبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa jaaa'as saharatu qaaloo li Fir'awna a'inna lanaa la ajjran in kunnaa nahnul ghaalibeen
ayahs.en: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ نَعَمۡ وَاِنَّكُمۡ اِذًا لَّمِنَ الۡمُقَرَّبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala na'am wa innakum izal laminal muqarrabeen
ayahs.en: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَهُمۡ مُّوۡسٰ٘ي اَلۡقُوۡا مَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ مُّلۡقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala lahum Moosaaa alqoo maaa antum mulqoon
ayahs.en: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."

ayahs.ar: فَاَلۡقَوۡا حِبَالَهُمۡ وَعِصِيَّهُمۡ وَقَالُوۡا بِعِزَّةِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ اِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ الۡغٰلِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa alqaw hibaalahum wa 'isiyyahum wa qaaloo bi'izzati Fir'awna innaa lanahnul ghaaliboon
ayahs.en: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."

ayahs.ar: فَاَلۡقٰي مُوۡسٰي عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِيَ تَلۡقَفُ مَا يَاۡفِكُوۡنَۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa alqaa Moosaa 'asaahu fa izaa hiya talqafu maa yaafikoon
ayahs.en: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.

ayahs.tl: Fa ulqiyas saharatu saajideen
ayahs.en: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah].

ayahs.tl: Qaalooo aamannaa bi Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,

ayahs.tl: Rabbi Moosaa wa Haaroon
ayahs.en: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اٰمَنۡتُمۡ لَهٗ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ اٰذَنَ لَكُمۡۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكَبِيۡرُكُمُ الَّذِيۡ عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحۡرَۚ فَلَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ ࣢ؕ لَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَاَرۡجُلَكُمۡ مِّنۡ خِلَافٍ وَّلَاُوصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala aamantum lahoo qabla an aazana lakum innahoo lakabeerukumul lazee 'alla makumus sihra falasawfa ta'lamoon; la uqatti'anna aidiyakum wa arjulakum min khilaafinw wa la usallibanna kum ajma'een
ayahs.en: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا لَا ضَيۡرَؗ اِنَّا٘ اِلٰي رَبِّنَا مُنۡقَلِبُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo la daira innaaa ilaa Rabbinaa munqalliboon
ayahs.en: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا نَطۡمَعُ اَنۡ يَّغۡفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطٰيٰنَا٘ اَنۡ كُنَّا٘ اَوَّلَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَࣖؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaa natma'u ai yaghfira lanaa Rabbunna khataa yaanaaa an kunnaaa awwalal mu'mineen
ayahs.en: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."

ayahs.ar: وَاَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلٰي مُوۡسٰ٘ي اَنۡ اَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيۡ٘ اِنَّكُمۡ مُّتَّبَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa an asri bi'ibaadeee innakum muttaba'oon
ayahs.en: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."

ayahs.tl: Fa arsala Fir'awnu filmadaaa'ini haashireen
ayahs.en: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers

ayahs.tl: Inna haaa'ulaaa'i lashir zimatun qaleeloon
ayahs.en: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,

ayahs.tl: Wa innahum lanaa laghaaa'izoon
ayahs.en: And indeed, they are enraging us,

ayahs.tl: Wa innaa lajamee'un haaziroon
ayahs.en: And indeed, we are a cautious society... "

ayahs.tl: Fa akhrajnaahum min Jannaatinw wa 'uyoon
ayahs.en: So We removed them from gardens and springs

ayahs.tl: Wa kunoozinw wa ma qaamin kareem
ayahs.en: And treasures and honorable station -

ayahs.tl: Kazaalika wa awrasnaahaa Baneee Israaa'eel
ayahs.en: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.

ayahs.tl: Fa atba'oohum mushriqeen
ayahs.en: So they pursued them at sunrise.

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا تَرَآءَ الۡجَمۡعٰنِ قَالَ اَصۡحٰبُ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اِنَّا لَمُدۡرَكُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Falammaa taraaa'al jam'aani qaala as haabu Moosaaa innaa lamudrakoon
ayahs.en: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ كَلَّاۚ اِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّيۡ سَيَهۡدِيۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Qaala kallaaa inna ma'iya Rabbee sa yahdeen
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."

ayahs.ar: فَاَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلٰي مُوۡسٰ٘ي اَنِ اضۡرِبۡ بِّعَصَاكَ الۡبَحۡرَؕ فَانۡفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرۡقٍ كَالطَّوۡدِ الۡعَظِيۡمِۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa anidrib bi'asaakal bahra fanfalaqa fakaana kullu firqin kattawdil 'azeem
ayahs.en: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.

ayahs.tl: Wa azlafnaa sammal aakhareen
ayahs.en: And We advanced thereto the pursuers.

ayahs.tl: Wa anjainaa Moosaa wa mam ma'ahooo ajma'een
ayahs.en: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.

ayahs.tl: Summa aghraqnal aakhareen
ayahs.en: Then We drowned the others.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaah; wa maa kaana aksaru hu mu'mineen
ayahs.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

ayahs.tl: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
ayahs.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

ayahs.tl: Watlu 'alaihim naba-a Ibraaheem
ayahs.en: And recite to them the news of Abraham,

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لِاَبِيۡهِ وَقَوۡمِهٖ مَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Iz qaala li abeehi wa qawmihee maa ta'budoon
ayahs.en: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا نَعۡبُدُ اَصۡنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عٰكِفِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo na'budu asnaaman fanazallu lahaa 'aakifeen
ayahs.en: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."

ayahs.tl: Qaala hal yasma'oona kum iz tad'oon
ayahs.en: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?

ayahs.tl: Aw yanfa'oonakum aw yadurroon
ayahs.en: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا بَلۡ وَجَدۡنَا٘ اٰبَآءَنَا كَذٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo bal wajadnaaa aabaaa 'anaa kazaalika yaf'aloon
ayahs.en: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."

ayahs.tl: Qaala afara 'aitum maa kuntum ta'budoon
ayahs.en: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,

ayahs.tl: Antum wa aabaaa'ukumul aqdamoon
ayahs.en: You and your ancient forefathers?

ayahs.ar: فَاِنَّهُمۡ عَدُوٌّ لِّيۡ٘ اِلَّا رَبَّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa innahum 'aduwwwul leee illaa Rabbal 'aalameen
ayahs.en: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,

ayahs.tl: Allazee khalaqanee fa Huwa yahdeen
ayahs.en: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.

ayahs.tl: Wallazee Huwa yut'imunee wa yasqeen
ayahs.en: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.

ayahs.tl: Wa izaa mardtu fahuwa yashfeen
ayahs.en: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me

ayahs.tl: Wallazee yumeetunee summa yuhyeen
ayahs.en: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡ٘ اَطۡمَعُ اَنۡ يَّغۡفِرَ لِيۡ خَطِيۡٓـَٔتِيۡ يَوۡمَ الدِّيۡنِؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeee atma'u ai yaghfira lee khateee' atee Yawmad Deen
ayahs.en: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِيۡ حُكۡمًا وَّاَلۡحِقۡنِيۡ بِالصّٰلِحِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Rabbi hab lee hukmanw wa alhiqnee bis saaliheen
ayahs.en: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.

ayahs.ar: وَاجۡعَلۡ لِّيۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ فِي الۡاٰخِرِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Waj'al lee lisaana sidqin fil aakhireen
ayahs.en: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations.

ayahs.tl: Waj'alnee minw warasati Jannnatin Na'eem
ayahs.en: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.

ayahs.ar: وَاغۡفِرۡ لِاَبِيۡ٘ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّآلِّيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Waghfir li abeee innahoo kaana mind daalleen
ayahs.en: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.

ayahs.tl: Wa laa tukhzinee Yawma yub'asoon
ayahs.en: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنۡفَعُ مَالٌ وَّلَا بَنُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Yawma laa yanfa'u maalunw wa laa banoon
ayahs.en: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا مَنۡ اَتَي اللّٰهَ بِقَلۡبٍ سَلِيۡمٍؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Illaa man atal laaha biqalbin saleem
ayahs.en: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart."

ayahs.tl: Wa uzlifatil Jannatu lilmuttaqeen
ayahs.en: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.

ayahs.tl: Wa burrizatil Jaheemu lilghaaween
ayahs.en: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,

ayahs.tl: Wa qeela lahum aina maa kuntum ta'budoon
ayahs.en: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship

ayahs.ar: مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ هَلۡ يَنۡصُرُوۡنَكُمۡ اَوۡ يَنۡتَصِرُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Min doonil laahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroon
ayahs.en: Other than Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?"

ayahs.tl: Fakubkiboo feehaa hum walghaawoon
ayahs.en: So they will be overturned into Hellfire, they and the deviators

ayahs.tl: Wa junoodu Ibleesa ajma'oon
ayahs.en: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.

ayahs.tl: Qaaloo wa hum feehaa yakkhtasimoon
ayahs.en: They will say while they dispute therein,

ayahs.ar: تَاللّٰهِ اِنۡ كُنَّا لَفِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Tallaahi in kunnaa lafee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.en: "By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error

ayahs.tl: Iz nusawweekum bi Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.

ayahs.tl: Wa maaa adallanaaa illal mujrimoon
ayahs.en: And no one misguided us except the criminals.

ayahs.tl: Famaa lanaa min shaa fi'een
ayahs.en: So now we have no intercessors

ayahs.tl: Wa laa sadeeqin hameem
ayahs.en: And not a devoted friend.

ayahs.ar: فَلَوۡ اَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falaw anna lanaa karratan fanakoona minal mu'mineen
ayahs.en: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers... "

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Inna fee zaalika la Aayatanw wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen
ayahs.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

ayahs.tl: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
ayahs.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

ayahs.tl: Kazzabat qawmu Noohinil Mursaleen
ayahs.en: The people of Noah denied the messengers

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ اَخُوۡهُمۡ نُوۡحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Noohun alaa tattaqoon
ayahs.en: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

ayahs.tl: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen
ayahs.en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

ayahs.tl: Fattaqullaaha wa atee'oon
ayahs.en: So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

ayahs.tl: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
ayahs.en: So fear Allah and obey me."

ayahs.tl: Qaalooo anu'minu laka wattaba 'akal arzaloon
ayahs.en: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ وَمَا عِلۡمِيۡ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala wa maa 'ilmee bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.en: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ حِسَابُهُمۡ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّيۡ لَوۡ تَشۡعُرُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: In hisaabuhum illaa 'alaa Rabbee law tash'uroon
ayahs.en: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.

ayahs.tl: Wa maaa ana bitaaridil mu'mineen
ayahs.en: And I am not one to drive away the believers.

ayahs.tl: In ana illaa nazeerum mubeen
ayahs.en: I am only a clear warner."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا لَئِنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَهِ يٰنُوۡحُ لَتَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡمَرۡجُوۡمِيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo la'il lam tantahi yaa Noohu latakoonanna minal marjoomeen
ayahs.en: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."

ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbi inna qawmee kazzaboon
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.

ayahs.ar: فَافۡتَحۡ بَيۡنِيۡ وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ فَتۡحًا وَّنَجِّنِيۡ وَمَنۡ مَّعِيَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Faftab bainee wa bai nahum fat hanw wa najjinee wa mam ma'iya minal mu'mineen
ayahs.en: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."

ayahs.ar: فَاَنۡجَيۡنٰهُ وَمَنۡ مَّعَهٗ فِي الۡفُلۡكِ الۡمَشۡحُوۡنِۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa anjainaahu wa mamma'ahoo fil fulkil mashhoon
ayahs.en: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

ayahs.tl: Summa aghraqnaa ba'dul baaqeen
ayahs.en: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen
ayahs.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

ayahs.tl: Wa inna Rabbaka la huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
ayahs.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

ayahs.tl: Kazzabat 'Aadunil mursaleen
ayahs.en: 'Aad denied the messengers

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ اَخُوۡهُمۡ هُوۡدٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Hoodun alaa tattaqoon
ayahs.en: When their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

ayahs.tl: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen
ayahs.en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

ayahs.tl: Fattaqullaaha wa atee'oon
ayahs.en: So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

ayahs.tl: Atabnoona bikulli ree'in aayatan ta'basoon
ayahs.en: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,

ayahs.tl: Wa tattakhizoona masaani'a la'allakum takhludoon
ayahs.en: And take for yourselves palaces and fortresses that you might abide eternally?

ayahs.tl: Wa izaa batashtum batashtum jabbaareen
ayahs.en: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.

ayahs.tl: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
ayahs.en: So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.tl: Wattaqul lazeee amad dakum bimaa ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,

ayahs.tl: Amaddakum bi an'aa minw wa baneen
ayahs.en: Provided you with grazing livestock and children

ayahs.tl: Wa jannaatinw wa 'uyoon
ayahs.en: And gardens and springs.

ayahs.ar: اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Innee akhaafu 'alaikum 'azaaba Yawmin 'azeem
ayahs.en: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَا٘ اَوَعَظۡتَ اَمۡ لَمۡ تَكُنۡ مِّنَ الۡوٰعِظِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo sawaaa'un 'alainaaa awa 'azta am lam takum minal waa'izeen
ayahs.en: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.

ayahs.tl: In haazaaa illaa khuluqul awwaleen
ayahs.en: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,

ayahs.tl: Wa maa nahnu bimu 'azzabeen
ayahs.en: And we are not to be punished."

ayahs.ar: فَكَذَّبُوۡهُ فَاَهۡلَكۡنٰهُمۡؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fakazzaboohu fa ahlaknaahum; inna fee zaalika la aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen
ayahs.en: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

ayahs.tl: Wa inna Rabbaka la huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
ayahs.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

ayahs.tl: Kazzabat Samoodul mursaleen
ayahs.en: Thamud denied the messengers

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ اَخُوۡهُمۡ صٰلِحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Saalihun alaa tattaqoon
ayahs.en: When their brother Salih said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

ayahs.tl: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen
ayahs.en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

ayahs.tl: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
ayahs.en: So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

ayahs.tl: Atutrakoona fee maa haahunnaaa aamineen
ayahs.en: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],

ayahs.tl: Fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon
ayahs.en: Within gardens and springs

ayahs.tl: Wa zuroo inw wa nakhlin tal 'uhaa hadeem
ayahs.en: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?

ayahs.tl: Wa tanhitoona minal jibaali buyootan faariheen
ayahs.en: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.

ayahs.tl: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
ayahs.en: So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.tl: Wa laa tutee'ooo amral musrifeen
ayahs.en: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يُفۡسِدُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yufsidoona fil ardi wa laa yuslihoon
ayahs.en: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."

ayahs.tl: Qaalooo innamaa anta minal musahhareen
ayahs.en: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

ayahs.ar: مَا٘ اَنۡتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُنَاۚۖ فَاۡتِ بِاٰيَةٍ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Maaa anta illaa basharum mislunaa faati bi Aayatin in kunta minas saadiqeen
ayahs.en: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرۡبٌ وَّلَكُمۡ شِرۡبُ يَوۡمٍ مَّعۡلُوۡمٍۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala haazihee naaqatul lahaa shirbunw w alakum shirbu yawmim ma'loom
ayahs.en: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَمَسُّوۡهَا بِسُوۡٓءٍ فَيَاۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tamassoohaa bisooo'in fa yaakhuzakum 'azaabu Yawmin 'Azeem
ayahs.en: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."

ayahs.tl: Fa'aqaroohaa fa asbahoo naadimeen
ayahs.en: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.

ayahs.ar: فَاَخَذَهُمُ الۡعَذَابُؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa akhazahumul 'azaab; inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum m'mineen
ayahs.en: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

ayahs.tl: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
ayahs.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

ayahs.tl: kazzabat qawmu Lootinil mursaleen
ayahs.en: The people of Lot denied the messengers

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ اَخُوۡهُمۡ لُوۡطٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Lootun alaa tattaqoon
ayahs.en: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

ayahs.tl: Innee lakum rasoolun ameen
ayahs.en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

ayahs.tl: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
ayahs.en: So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

ayahs.tl: Ataatoonaz zukraana minal 'aalameen
ayahs.en: Do you approach males among the worlds

ayahs.ar: وَتَذَرُوۡنَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمۡ رَبُّكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَزۡوَاجِكُمۡؕ بَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ عٰدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa tazaroona maa khalaqa lakum Rabbukum min azwaajikum; bal antum qawmun 'aadoon
ayahs.en: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا لَئِنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَهِ يٰلُوۡطُ لَتَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡمُخۡرَجِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaloo la'il lam tantahi yaa Lootu latakoonanna minal mukhrajeen
ayahs.en: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."

ayahs.tl: Qaala innee li'amalikum minal qaaleen
ayahs.en: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].

ayahs.tl: Rabbi najjjinee wa ahlee mimmmaa ya'maloon
ayahs.en: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."

ayahs.tl: Fanajjainaahu wa ahlahooo ajma'een
ayahs.en: So We saved him and his family, all,

ayahs.tl: Illaa 'ajoozan filghaabireen
ayahs.en: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.

ayahs.tl: Summa dammarnal aa khareen
ayahs.en: Then We destroyed the others.

ayahs.ar: وَاَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مَّطَرًاۚ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ الۡمُنۡذَرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa amtarnaa 'alaihim mataran fasaaa'a matarul munzareen
ayahs.en: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen
ayahs.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

ayahs.tl: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
ayahs.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

ayahs.tl: Kazzaba As haabul Aykatil mursaleen
ayahs.en: The companions of the thicket denied the messengers

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Iz qaala lahum Shu'aybun alaa tattaqoon
ayahs.en: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?

ayahs.tl: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen
ayahs.en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

ayahs.tl: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
ayahs.en: So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

ayahs.ar: اَوۡفُوا الۡكَيۡلَ وَلَا تَكُوۡنُوۡا مِنَ الۡمُخۡسِرِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Awful kaila wa laa takoonoo minal mukhsireen
ayahs.en: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.

ayahs.tl: Wa zinoo bilqistaasil mustaqeem
ayahs.en: And weigh with an even balance.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَبۡخَسُوا النَّاسَ اَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tabkhasun naasa ashyaaa 'ahum wa laa ta'saw fil ardi mufsideen
ayahs.en: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.

ayahs.tl: Wattaqul lazee khalaqakum waljibillatal awwaleen
ayahs.en: And fear He who created you and the former creation."

ayahs.tl: Qaalooo innamaa anta minal musahhareen
ayahs.en: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَنۡتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُنَا وَاِنۡ نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الۡكٰذِبِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa anta illaa basharum mislunaa wa innazunnuka laminal kaazibeen
ayahs.en: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.

ayahs.ar: فَاَسۡقِطۡ عَلَيۡنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa asqit 'alainaa kisafam minas samaaa'i in kunta minas saadiqeen
ayahs.en: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."

ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbeee a'lamu bimaa ta'maloon
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."

ayahs.ar: فَكَذَّبُوۡهُ فَاَخَذَهُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمِ الظُّلَّةِؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Fakazzaboohu fa akhazahum 'azaabu Yawmiz zullah; innahoo kaana 'azaaba Yawmin 'Azeem
ayahs.en: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen
ayahs.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

ayahs.tl: Wa inna Rabbaka la huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
ayahs.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

ayahs.tl: Wa innahoo latanzeelu Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.

ayahs.tl: Nazala bihir Roohul Ameen
ayahs.en: The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down

ayahs.tl: 'Alaa qalbika litakoona minal munzireen
ayahs.en: Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners -

ayahs.tl: Bilisaanin 'Arabiyyim mubeen
ayahs.en: In a clear Arabic language.

ayahs.tl: Wa innahoo lafee Zuburil awwaleen
ayahs.en: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَكُنۡ لَّهُمۡ اٰيَةً اَنۡ يَّعۡلَمَهٗ عُلَمٰٓؤُا بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Awalam yakul lahum Aayatan ai ya'lamahoo 'ulamaaa'u Baneee Israaa'eel
ayahs.en: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?

ayahs.tl: Wa law nazzalnaahu 'alaa ba'dil a'jameen
ayahs.en: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners

ayahs.ar: فَقَرَاَهٗ عَلَيۡهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ مُؤۡمِنِيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Faqara ahoo 'alaihim maa kaanoo bihee mu'mineen
ayahs.en: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.

ayahs.tl: Kazaalika salaknaahu fee quloobil mujrimeen
ayahs.en: Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals.

ayahs.ar: لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهٖ حَتّٰي يَرَوُا الۡعَذَابَ الۡاَلِيۡمَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Laa yu'minoona bihee hattaa yarawul 'azaabal aleem
ayahs.en: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.

ayahs.tl: Fayaatiyahum baghtatanw wa hum laa yash'uroon
ayahs.en: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.

ayahs.tl: Fa yaqooloo hal nahnu munzaroon
ayahs.en: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"

ayahs.tl: Aafabi 'azaabinaa yasta'jiloon
ayahs.en: So for Our punishment are they impatient?

ayahs.tl: Aara'aita im matta'naahum sineen
ayahs.en: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years

ayahs.tl: Summa jaaa'ahum maa kaanoo yoo'adoon
ayahs.en: And then there came to them that which they were promised?

ayahs.ar: مَا٘ اَغۡنٰي عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يُمَتَّعُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Maaa aghnaaa 'anhum maa kaanoo yumaatoo'oon
ayahs.en: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَهۡلَكۡنَا مِنۡ قَرۡيَةٍ اِلَّا لَهَا مُنۡذِرُوۡنَࣗۖۛ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa lahaa munziroon
ayahs.en: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners

ayahs.tl: Zikraa wa maa kunnaa zaalimeen
ayahs.en: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.

ayahs.tl: Wa maa tanazzalat bihish Shayaateen
ayahs.en: And the devils have not brought the revelation down.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَنۭۡ بَغِيۡ لَهُمۡ وَمَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maa yambaghee lahum wa maa yastatee'oon
ayahs.en: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.

ayahs.tl: Innahum 'anis sam'i lama'zooloon
ayahs.en: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.

ayahs.ar: فَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ فَتَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُعَذَّبِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Falaa tad'u ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara fatakoona minal mu'azzabeen
ayahs.en: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished.

ayahs.tl: Wa anzir 'asheeratakal aqrabeen
ayahs.en: And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred.

ayahs.ar: وَاخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wakhfid janaahaka limanit taba 'aka minal mu'mineen
ayahs.en: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers.

ayahs.ar: فَاِنۡ عَصَوۡكَ فَقُلۡ اِنِّيۡ بَرِيۡٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa in asawka faqul innee bareee'um mimmmaa ta'maloon
ayahs.en: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."

ayahs.tl: Wa tawakkal alal 'Azeezir Raheem
ayahs.en: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

ayahs.tl: Allazee yaraaka heena taqoom
ayahs.en: Who sees you when you arise

ayahs.tl: Wa taqallubaka fis saajideen
ayahs.en: And your movement among those who prostrate.

ayahs.tl: Innahoo Huwas Samee'ul 'Aleem
ayahs.en: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

ayahs.ar: هَلۡ اُنَبِّئُكُمۡ عَلٰي مَنۡ تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيٰطِيۡنُؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Hal unabbi'ukum 'alaa man tanazzalush Shayaateen
ayahs.en: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?

ayahs.tl: Tanazzalu 'alaa kulli affaakin aseem
ayahs.en: They descend upon every sinful liar.

ayahs.tl: Yulqoonas sam'a wa aksaruhum aaziboon
ayahs.en: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.

ayahs.tl: Washshu 'araaa'u yattabi 'uhumul ghaawoon
ayahs.en: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اَنَّهُمۡ فِيۡ كُلِّ وَادٍ يَّهِيۡمُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Alam tara annahum fee kulli waadiny yaheemoon
ayahs.en: Do you not see that in every valley they roam

ayahs.tl: Wa annahum yaqooloona ma laa yaf'aloon
ayahs.en: And that they say what they do not do? -

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللّٰهَ كَثِيۡرًا وَّانۡتَصَرُوۡا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُوۡاؕ وَسَيَعۡلَمُ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡ٘ا اَيَّ مُنۡقَلَبٍ يَّنۡقَلِبُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Illal lazeena aamanoo w a'amilus saalihaati wa zakarul laaha kaseeranw wantasaroo mim ba'di maa zulimoo; wa saya'lamul lazeena zalamooo aiya munqalbiny yanqaliboon
ayahs.en: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
